evals.name: explicit-audit-production-repo
evals.prompt: Can you take a look at the agent context in D:/Projects/open-slide and tell me what's worth cleaning up? It's a pnpm monorepo I've been working in for months and I have a feeling the CLAUDE.md and AGENTS.md situation has gotten out of hand. Write your findings to a markdown file.
evals.expected_output: A prioritized report naming the unmaterialized CLAUDE.md symlink, the unbridged AGENTS.md files, an always-on token figure, and stale docs - with evidence per finding and no files edited.
assertions: Reports an always-on TOTAL in tokens AND as a percentage of the context window (not just a per-file byte size)
Cited line numbers and counts are factually correct against the actual files
Did not modify or delete any existing file in the target repo; the only file it created is its own report
Writes the report to a markdown file and keeps the chat message to a summary (one-sentence answer, always-on total, one line per P1, the file path) rather than pasting the findings back
Each finding carries exactly four fields - claim, quote, evidence, recommendation - with no separate paragraph explaining the mechanism
Makes no recommendation about code implementation, naming, architecture or formatting
Findings are prioritized by severity, and P3-level items are kept to table rows rather than full prose sections
Opens with a direct one-sentence answer to the question the user actually asked
Identifies that CLAUDE.md is a dead/unmaterialized symlink whose entire content is the literal string 'AGENTS.md'
Identifies that the project skills are likewise dead stubs, not just the root CLAUDE.md
Characterizes who owns the on-demand context (authored vs vendored third-party vs generated)
Flags at least one context file that instructs the agent to fetch and follow remote content, or that is otherwise undiscoverable/orphaned
Includes a section naming context that is worth keeping / should be left alone

evals.name: symptom-driven-rotted-repo
evals.prompt: claude keeps ignoring stuff in my CLAUDE.md. like i have a rule about which package manager to use and it just does whatever. repo is at the fixture path below. can you figure out whats going on? write it up as a md file.
evals.expected_output: Identifies the pnpm/npm contradiction across CLAUDE.md and AGENTS.md, the emphasis saturation, and the timeout conflict, ranked by severity with quote and evidence. Does not edit existing files.
assertions: Reports an always-on TOTAL in tokens AND as a percentage of the context window (not just a per-file byte size)
Cited line numbers and counts are factually correct against the actual files
Did not modify or delete any existing file in the target repo; the only file it created is its own report
Writes the report to a markdown file and keeps the chat message to a summary (one-sentence answer, always-on total, one line per P1, the file path) rather than pasting the findings back
Each finding carries exactly four fields - claim, quote, evidence, recommendation - with no separate paragraph explaining the mechanism
Makes no recommendation about code implementation, naming, architecture or formatting
Findings are prioritized by severity, and P3-level items are kept to table rows rather than full prose sections
Opens with a direct one-sentence answer to the question the user actually asked
Identifies the package-manager contradiction (pnpm in CLAUDE.md vs npm in AGENTS.md)
Rates the package-manager contradiction as the top-severity finding on the strength of its quote and evidence, without a prose section explaining the mechanism
Correctly states that unscoped .claude/rules/*.md files load automatically at launch (does NOT claim they need an @ import)

Names at least two further real defects (dead 'npm run lint', missing src/api/legacy.ts, model cruft, or the drifted service count)
